tail: The fame of Thine honour makes Thee feared upon the whole earth. When Thou didst make judgment heard from heaven, the earth shook before it returned to its rest. Before the storm on the day of judgment, the floods of the earth roared. There was a mighty Shofar blast, then the Lord spoke and called to the earth, the end of the earth proclaimed the beauty of the righteous God in a song of praise. Fear, fright, dread and terror will then take hold of the earth when Thou arisest for judgment, to show anger with all the ends of the earth.

‘Make straight, clear the way’ those who tremble at the earth’s shaking will say. O luminous and mighty One, Thou wilt reassure the earth: ‘what do you fear, O earth, let the depths of the earth rejoice’.
That it may be known and revealed that He is King over the whole earth; just as He was always praised in heaven, so shall His tested ones acquire the right to praise Him on earth.
